info.title: Knowledge graph L2: Task Entry API
info.description: One task of a DAK business process, as the DAK document's "notes and annotations" describe it: identifier, name, description, and the personas, data elements, requirements and decision tables it links to. A node rather than a property because the same task is also drawn in the BPMN file, and the two have to be joinable to be checkable against each other (`describes`). Read from a BPMN file's `dak-task-annotations/v1` sidecar (smart-base/L2-bpmn/schemas/task-annotations.ts); BusinessProcessWorkflow's `task 0..*` backbone carries the first three fields of the same thing. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/dak-task.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for KGDakTask logical model

name.description: The computable name: the CamelCase identifier a Canonical() reference matches on.

description.description: A description, as the source gives it.

activityId.description: The DAK activity id (`IMMZ.B1`, `TB.A5`): the process id and the step number, the key the DAK spreadsheets use.

matchedBy.description: How the annotation was joined to its BPMN task: `id`, `step-number`, `name` or `adjudicated` by a person.

sourceDocument.description: The L1 library document the annotation was read from.

sourceItem.description: The annotation's item number as printed (`1`, `2.3`).

source.description: Where the node was read from: a repository path or URL.
